name: Canadian International School (Lakeside)
summary: IB World School on Jurong West / Lakeside with popular bilingual Mandarin tracks — shortlist when Mandarin hours matter as much as the sports hall.
body: CIS Lakeside offers IB programmes with a Canadian-influenced pastoral approach and bilingual Mandarin options that r/askSingapore Mandarin-seeking families often shortlist beside Dulwich language pathways. West campus geography pulls Jurong, Clementi, and west Bukit Timah housing — model peak school-bus minutes before signing an East Coast lease. Bilingual tracks fill faster than the English stream; ask admissions for dated openings by grade and weekly Mandarin contact hours (immersion vs optional language). Confirm current campus map and fee stack (enrolment, capital, bus) on cis.edu.sg — treat aggregator screenshots as stale.
waitlistNotes: Bilingual tracks fill faster — ask admissions for current openings by grade and confirm Mandarin contact hours in writing.
